info.title: retooled-patch
info.description: The retooled-patch command, which builds, checks, applies and reverts KSP Retooled patch files.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Builds, checks, applies and reverts KSP Retooled patch files.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: -h
options.description: Show short help.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show detailed help.

options.name: --source
options.description: A stock install that the patch should accept. Repeat --source once for each install.

options.name: --target
options.description: The KSP Retooled build that the patch should produce.

options.name: --out
options.description: The patch file to write.

options.name: --platform
options.description: The platform that the patch is for.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Paths to leave out of every source and the target.

options.name: --exclude-target
options.description: Paths to leave out of the target only.

options.name: --copy
options.description: Files or directories to copy unchanged from the install, instead of patching them.

options.name: --jobs
options.description: How many worker threads to use. [default: 4]

options.name: --level
options.description: The zstd compression level. [default: 19]

options.name: --window
options.description: The zstd window size, as a power of 2. [default: 27]

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show what a patch file contains.

options.name: --patch
options.description: The patch file to describe.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check whether a patch can be applied to an install.

options.name: --install
options.description: The KSP install to check.

options.name: --patch
options.description: The patch file to check the install against.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply a patch to a stock install.

options.name: --install
options.description: The stock KSP install to patch.

options.name: --patch
options.description: The patch file to apply.

options.name: --out
options.description: Writes a patched copy of the install to <new-dir>.

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Patches the install directly. [default: False]

options.name: --install
options.description: The install that was patched with apply --in-place.
